lock_mode_before_rebase.meaning: value of the lockMode field immediately before rebaseOraclePack executes

lock_mode_after_rebase.meaning: value of the lockMode field after rebaseOraclePack executes

assumptions: rebaseOraclePack is invoked on an OraclePack whose lockMode field holds some existing value before the call.

unresolved.description: The report does not state the exact prior lockMode value in the selected statements; the intent only requires preservation of whatever existing value is present, so the expected value is bound symbolically to lock_mode_before_rebase.
The report does not state the caller or invocation conditions of rebaseOraclePack, so no caller/authorization qualifier can be encoded in the condition.

limitations: The condition uses a rebase_executed occurrence flag that is not declared among the symbols; the program must bind it as a bool occurrence symbol for the rebaseOraclePack execution event.
No precondition sources were frozen, so the P conjunction is empty and the claim is evaluated for any OraclePack state before rebase.
